packageRules.description: Patched through pnpm patchedDependencies. boneyard-js is keyed by bare name, so a bump that still applies cleanly but no longer patches what the diff was written against is silent; vaul is keyed with its version, so a bump fails the install loudly instead, and a human has to regenerate the patch either way. A human reads the upstream diff.

A docs-only dependency bump must not read as an app change. Attribution is by path, so semantic-release already books it against apps/docs, and the commit type keeps the pull request title saying the same thing. Only the type changes; the automerge rules above still apply.
